verdict.rationale: Rippling says current and past employees can view tax forms in self-service, which suggests some year-end form distribution. It also automatically calculates and files payroll taxes, but agency filing is a different capability from issuing W-2s/1099s to workers, so it is not credited. There is no explicit evidence of automatic year-end W-2 or 1099 generation. Missing for 10: explicit W-2 generation, 1099 generation for contractors, automated year-end distribution workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end

citations.quote: letting current and past employees view pay stubs and tax forms at any time
